provenance: Additional native answer cohort over the unchanged frozen synthetic corpus. Query, gold source and rubric are copied verbatim from existing answer cases; no new labels, rubric or thresholds. Continues the existing 15-query rotation (claude 00-14, codex 15-29, fuigo 30-04, api-only 05-19). Not evidence until a named, root-authorised native run.
thresholds: Pre-run gate: quality targets, named model routes and spend/time ceilings are selected by root before any run; none are chosen here.

cohorts.receipt: Each run must record the actual engine kind, binary hash, model id, delivered memory bundle and visible answer per case.
